st.headline: HSBC first-half profit jumps 23% on higher rates, robust wealth growth
st.teaser: HSBC announced a resumption of its share buybacks with an up to US$1 billion plan.
fullText: HONG KONG/LONDON - HSBC Holdings reported on Aug 4 a 23 per cent first-half profit surge that bettered expectations, as rising net interest income and revenue from wealth management pushed up fee income on robust money and deal flows.
Europe’s largest bank posted a pretax profit of US$19.5 billion (S$25 billion) for the first six months of this year, versus US$15.8 billion a year earlier.
That compared with the US$18.9 billion average of broker estimates compiled by HSBC.
HSBC announced a resumption of its share buybacks with an up to US$1 billion plan, the first since it took smaller Hong Kong lender Hang Seng Bank private.
The bank also announced a second interim dividend of 10 US cents per share, following a similar payout in May. REUTERS

cna.headline: Maroon 5 to perform at Singapore's National Stadium in February 2027
cna.teaser: The American pop band is returning to Singapore for a one-night concert on Feb 12, 2027. Tickets go on sale from Aug 11.
fullText: Maroon 5 fans can mark their calendars: The Grammy-winning American band will return to Singapore to perform at the National Stadium on Feb 12, 2027.
Tickets will first be available on Ticketmaster through the Maroon 5 artist presale on Aug 11, from 10am to 11.59pm, for active standard Maroon 5 S.I.N. fan club members.
The UOB Reserve and Visa Infinite Cards presale will run on Aug 12 from 10am to 3pm, followed by the UOB Visa Cards presale from 5pm on Aug 12 to 10am on Aug 13.
The Live Nation presale for members will take place on Aug 13, from 12pm to 11.59pm. General ticket sales start on Aug 14 at 10am.

Known for hits such as She Will Be Loved, Payphone, Moves Like Jagger and Won't Go Home Without You, the band is bringing its latest international tour to Singapore as part of its Asia leg, which also includes stops in Kaohsiung, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Manila and Bangkok.

Maroon 5 recently wrapped up the European leg of their tour, as well as 24 arena shows across the United States in support of their latest album Love Is Like. The group's latest single, Heroine, was released in May.

The band first performed in Singapore at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in 2008 and went on to perform at the 2012 and 2015 Singapore Grand Prix. The group's most recent Singapore concert was at the National Stadium in November 2022.

economistArticle.title: The Frugal Frontier: How China Wins Better Bang for Its Buck in AI
paras: While Silicon Valley dominates global headlines with massive capital injections into compute-heavy large language models, China is quietly charting a different, more resource-efficient path. The sheer volume of venture capital flowing into American AI startups dwarfs Beijing’s investments. Yet, Chinese developers are proving that financial profligacy is not the only route to algorithmic sophistication.

This disparity in spending highlights a fundamental strategic divergence. American tech giants are engaged in a brute-force arms race, buying up advanced Nvidia chips and consuming vast pools of electricity to train ever-larger models. Conversely, Chinese firms, constrained by Western export restrictions on hardware, have had to innovate under pressure. They are focus-building smaller, highly optimised models designed to run efficiently on less powerful silicon, maximizing their computational output per dollar spent.

Pragmatism dictates this frugality. In China, the immediate goal of AI development is not the pursuit of artificial general intelligence, but rather the rapid commercial application of existing tech. From automated smart factories in Shenzhen to hyper-efficient logistics networks in Hangzhou, AI is treated as a practical utility rather than a speculative scientific frontier. This application-first approach yields immediate commercial dividends and practical data loops, which in turn feed back into model refinement.

Moreover, Chinese open-source communities are rapidly democratising these efficient models. By focusing on fine-tuning techniques like Low-Rank Adaptation and quantization, developers can run sophisticated models on standard consumer hardware. This bottom-up innovation reduces the entry barriers for smaller enterprises, fostering a vibrant ecosystem that does not rely on multi-billion-dollar sovereign wealth funds or tech conglomerates.

To be sure, America’s deep pockets and cutting-edge research facilities still give it a formidable edge in raw technological breakthroughs. However, capital efficiency is a metric that investors cannot ignore forever. As the initial AI hype cycle matures into a demand for sustainable business models, China’s ability to extract immense utility from modest resources may well redefine the economics of global technology competition.
economistArticle.cn:
尽管硅谷因向计算密集型大语言模型注入巨额资金而占据全球头条，但中国正默默开辟一条截然不同、且更具资源效率的道路。流向美国人工智能初创公司的风险投资总量让北京的投资相形见绌。然而，中国的开发人员正在证明，资金挥霍并非通往算法精细化的唯一途径。

这种消费上的差距凸显了战略上的根本分歧。美国科技巨头正处于一场“暴力破解”式的军备竞赛中，他们抢购先进的英伟达芯片，并消耗大量电力来训练体量更大的模型。相反，由于面临西方对硬件的出口限制，中国企业不得不在压力下进行创新。他们专注于构建体量更小、高度优化的模型，旨在让其在性能稍逊的芯片上高效运行，从而最大化每美元的计算输出。

务实主义决定了这种节俭。在中国，人工智能发展的直接目标并不是追求通用人工智能（AGI），而是将现有技术迅速进行商业应用。从深圳的自动化智能工厂到杭州的高效物流网络，人工智能被视为一种实用的工具，而非投机性的科学前沿。这种“应用优先”的方法带来了立竿见影的商业红利和实用的数据闭环，进而反哺模型的优化。

此外，中国的开源社区正在迅速普及这些高效的模型。通过专注于低秩适应（LoRA）和量化等微调技术，开发人员可以在普通的消费级硬件上运行复杂的模型。这种自下而上的创新降低了中小企业的准入门槛，培育了一个不依赖于数百亿美元主权财富基金或科技巨头的活力生态系统。

当然，美国雄厚的财力和尖端的研发设施使其在原始技术突破中仍拥有巨大优势。然而，资本效率是投资者永远无法忽视的指标。随着最初的人工智能炒作周期走向成熟、市场转而追求可持续的商业模式，中国从有限资源中榨取巨大效能的能力，很可能会重新定义全球科技竞争的经济学。
